invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Review drafts, issue in bulk, collect and correct. Base excl. VAT; total due incl. VAT.
invoices.readOnly: Read-only: a partner issues, collects and corrects invoices.

summary.pendingHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to collect} one {# invoice · incl. VAT} other {# invoices · incl. VAT}}
summary.overdueHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing overdue} one {# invoice · incl. VAT} other {# invoices · incl. VAT}}
summary.draftsHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to issue} other {{amount} incl. VAT}}

list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
list.truncated: Showing the {count} most recent: search by number or client to find the rest.

columns.totalHint: Total due: incl. VAT and net of IRPF
columns.outstandingHint: What's left to collect, incl. VAT

list.emptyBody: The daily run prepares the drafts for signed contracts: this is where you review them, issue them in bulk and collect them. For anything that doesn't come from a contract, create a manual invoice.
list.emptyReadOnly: When a partner issues the first one, it will appear here.

emptyFilter.draft: No drafts waiting to be issued.
emptyFilter.overdue: No overdue invoices: all up to date.

list.noResultsBody: Try another number or client, or switch tab.
list.keyboardHint: <kbd>J</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open · <kbd>C</kbd> for a manual invoice
list.keyboardHintDrafts: <kbd>J</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to move · <kbd>X</kbd> to select · <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open · <kbd>C</kbd> for a manual invoice

bulk.confirm: {count, plural, one {# invoice will be issued} other {# invoices will be issued}} with today's date, {date}. Once issued, they can't be modified.
bulk.confirmOwnDates: {count, plural, one {# of them keeps the date on its draft.} other {# of them keep the date on their drafts.}}
bulk.toastOk: {count, plural, one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}
bulk.toastPartial: {ok, plural, one {# issued} other {# issued}}, {failed, plural, one {# with an error} other {# with errors}}
bulk.resultsDescription: {ok, plural, =0 {None issued} one {# issued} other {# issued}} · {failed, plural, =0 {no errors} one {# with an error} other {# with errors}}
bulk.failedHint: The ones with errors stay as drafts and selected: fix what's missing and issue them again.

billingRun.hint: Does now what the daily run does: creates what's pending invoicing from contracts, builds the drafts and prepares the payment reminders.
billingRun.never: The daily run hasn't run yet
billingRun.done: Billing done: {drafts, plural, =0 {no new drafts} one {# draft prepared} other {# drafts prepared}} · {items, plural, =0 {nothing new pending} one {# new item} other {# new items}} · {emails, plural, =0 {no reminders} one {# reminder to approve} other {# reminders to approve}}
billingRun.nothing: All up to date: there was nothing new to invoice.

editor.readOnly: Read-only: a partner can edit and issue this draft.
editor.nextNumberUnknown: The number is assigned on issue
editor.nextNumberHint: Expected number with the current series and date. It isn't reserved: it's assigned on issue, with no gaps.
editor.lockedContract: It comes from a contract: the issuer and client are set there.
editor.lockedRectifying: A corrective invoice has the same issuer and client as the invoice it corrects.
editor.newClientHint: “{name}” isn't a client yet: create it first with its tax details.
editor.seriesHint: The issuer's series for this type of invoice.
editor.languageHint: The language of the PDF and the email; by default, the client's.
editor.operationOnHint: Only if it's different from the issue date.
editor.termsDefault: Empty: {days} days, {source, select, client {the client's} other {the organization's}}.
editor.duePreviewToday: If issued today, it will be due on {date}.
editor.irpfDefault: The default would be {rate}: the issuer's rate with this client.
editor.irpfHint: Applied to the lines subject to it. By default, the issuer's rate if the client is a company or professional in Spain.
editor.linesHint: Prices excl. VAT. Each line has its type: recurring, usage and one-off never mix.
editor.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the September price was applied incorrectly.
editor.notesPlaceholder: Shown on the PDF, at the foot of the invoice.
editor.issueBlockedVerifactu: This issuer is already required to use Verifactu: it can't issue with the internal provider.
editor.issueNoLines: Add at least one line to issue.
editor.issueConfirm: It will be issued as {number}, dated {date}. Once issued, it can't be modified: it's fixed with a corrective invoice.
editor.issueConfirmNoNumber: It will be issued dated {date}. Once issued, it can't be modified: it's fixed with a corrective invoice.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? Anything that came from contracts goes back to pending invoicing, and the next daily run will prepare it again.
editor.issuerInactive: This issuer can't issue today (because of its registration dates, or because the SL isn't incorporated yet).
editor.fiscalMissing: To issue it, you still need {fields}.

lines.fromContractHint: It comes from a contract: its type and period can't be changed here.
lines.removeLinkedTitle: This line comes from a contract. What should we do with it?
lines.keepPendingHint: It goes back to pending invoicing, and the next daily run will prepare it again.
lines.removedSummary: On saving, {count, plural, one {# contract line is removed:} other {# contract lines are removed:}}
lines.removedPending: {count, plural, one {# goes back to pending} other {# go back to pending}}
lines.removedWaived: {count, plural, one {# is waived} other {# are waived}}
lines.negativeHint: In a corrective invoice, whatever is credited goes in negative (price with a minus sign).
lines.empty: No lines. Add the first one to get started.

totals.totalHint: Incl. VAT and net of IRPF
totals.pendingLines: {count, plural, one {# incomplete line doesn't count yet} other {# incomplete lines don't count yet}}
totals.empty: Add lines to see the totals.

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.stale: Save to see the changes in the PDF.

verifactu.soonTitle: Verifactu in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
verifactu.soon: From {date}, {issuer} will have to issue invoices with a Verifactu provider. Until then, its invoices are issued here.
verifactu.requiredTitle: {issuer} is already required to use Verifactu
verifactu.required: Since {date}, it can't issue from GNERAI OS with the internal provider: the draft can be prepared, but not issued.

view.readOnly: Read-only: a partner records payments, sends and corrects invoices.
view.issuingBody: The PDF or the provider failed while issuing. Complete it: it keeps its number, {number}.
view.issuingBodyNoNumber: The PDF or the provider failed while issuing. Complete it to finish issuing.
view.overdueTitle: Overdue by {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
view.remindersPending: {count, plural, one {It has # reminder awaiting approval} other {It has # reminders awaiting approval}} in the <link>Outbox</link>.
view.voidedBody: Its corrective invoice brings it to zero: there's nothing to collect.
view.snapshotHint: Details frozen on issue: if the profile changes, the invoice doesn't.
view.linesCount: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · prices excl. VAT

payments.title: Payments
payments.amountHint: Incl. VAT. A negative amount is a refund.
payments.deleteConfirm: Delete this payment of {amount}? The invoice will show it as outstanding again.

recordPayment.title: Record payment
recordPayment.description: {client}: record what they've paid you. The payment date is the day the money arrived.
recordPayment.receivedHint: Type it and it's split across the invoices automatically, oldest first.
recordPayment.surplus: {amount} left over: there are no more outstanding invoices to apply it to.
recordPayment.invoices: {count, plural, one {Outstanding invoice} other {# outstanding invoices}}
recordPayment.paidOnHint: The day the money arrived; it doesn't have to match the invoice date.
recordPayment.beforeIssue: {count, plural, one {It's earlier than the date of {number}: is it an advance payment?} other {It's earlier than the date of some invoices (such as {number}): is it an advance payment?}}
recordPayment.savedToast: {count, plural, one {Payment of {amount} recorded} other {Payment of {amount} recorded across # invoices}}
recordPayment.invoicesHint: Tick the invoices this payment covers.

history.title: Billing history
history.description: What has been invoiced, collected and is still outstanding since the first invoice (imported ones included), by year, quarter or month.
history.emptyClient: {client} has no invoices or payments yet
history.emptyBody: Record what clients pay you from each client's file (with or without an invoice) or issue invoices: you'll see here how much was invoiced and collected in each period.

kpi.billedHint: Excl. VAT · {total} incl. VAT · {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
kpi.collectedHint: Incl. VAT · {percent} of what was invoiced
kpi.revenueHint: Excl. VAT · {billed} invoiced + {receipts} collected without an invoice
kpi.collectedReceiptsHint: From invoices (incl. VAT) and without an invoice ({receipts})

chart.title: Invoiced and collected
chart.description: All excl. VAT: invoiced by issue date and collected by the day the money arrived.
chart.descriptionCosts: All excl. VAT: invoiced, collected (by the day the money arrived) and the costs allocated to this client.
chart.invoices: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}

history.footnote: Net, VAT and IRPF by issue date (corrective invoices subtract in their period). No invoice: what was collected without an invoice, with no VAT. Collected (from invoices incl. VAT and without an invoice) by the day the money arrived. Outstanding: what is still due on the invoices issued in each period.
history.footnoteCosts: Costs: the net amount of the expenses allocated to this client, by their invoice date. The direct margin excludes hours and the shared server costs: see Profitability for those.

email.title: Send {number} by email
email.description: Review it before sending: it's in the client's language ({language}), with the invoice PDF attached.
email.noRecipients: The client has no billing contacts with an email: type the recipient.
email.subject: Subject
email.historyEmpty: It hasn't been sent by email yet.

rectify.title: Correct {number}
rectify.description: An issued invoice can't be modified: it's fixed with a corrective invoice, in the issuer's corrective series.

full.title: Void invoice
full.hint: Full correction: copies all the lines in negative. Once it's issued, this invoice is voided.

partial.title: By differences
partial.hint: Partial correction: it starts empty and you add only what's being corrected (whatever is credited, in negative).

rectify.fullDisabled: It already has corrective invoices issued: the next one is by differences.
rectify.reasonHint: Shown on the corrective invoice, next to the number of the invoice it corrects.
rectify.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the client cancelled on 15 September.
rectify.createdToast: Corrective invoice created as a draft: review and issue it

release.title: Contract items
release.body: The invoice is voided and had {count, plural, one {# contract item} other {# contract items}} (periods, usage or milestones). Should they be invoiced again or waived?
release.rebillHint: They go back to pending: the next daily run will put them in a new draft.
release.confirmRebill: Invoice {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} again? The next daily run will put {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} in a draft.
release.confirmWaive: Waive {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}? Waived items aren't invoiced again.
release.rebilledToast: {count, plural, one {# item goes} other {# items go}} back to pending invoicing
release.waivedToast: {count, plural, one {# item waived} other {# items waived}}

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.description: Payment reminders the daily run prepares {days} days after an invoice falls due. Nothing goes out until a partner sends it.
outbox.readOnly: Read-only: a partner reviews and sends the reminders.
outbox.emptyHint: When an invoice is {days} days overdue, its reminder will be here, ready to review and send.
outbox.noRecipients: No recipients: add one before sending
outbox.daysOverdue: Overdue by {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
outbox.settled: This invoice is no longer overdue: the reminder probably isn't needed.
outbox.discardConfirm: Discard this reminder? It won't be sent and will be marked as discarded.

clientCard.title: Invoices
clientCard.viewAll: {count, plural, one {View the invoice} other {View all #}}

validation.quantity: A quantity greater than 0, up to 3 decimals
validation.negativePrice: Only a corrective invoice can have negative prices
validation.billingTypeRequired: Choose the type: one-off, monthly, yearly or usage-based
validation.periodBoth: Enter the start and end of the period
validation.periodOrder: The end can't be before the start
validation.futureDate: It can't be a future date
validation.dueBeforeIssue: It can't be due before it's issued
validation.emails: One or more valid emails, separated by commas
validation.paidInFuture: A payment can't have a future date

errors.emailNotFound: This email is no longer pending.
errors.paymentNotOrdinary: Only ordinary invoices take payments: a corrective invoice adjusts what's left to pay on the original.

notFound.title: This invoice doesn't exist
notFound.body: The draft may have been deleted, the link may be wrong, or it may belong to another organization.

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.description: What is going to come in, payment by payment, invoice or not. Amounts excl. VAT.
upcoming.empty: No expected payments: no signed contract has monthly fees, yearly fees or pending payments.
upcoming.hint: Billing is in advance, on the payment day, following each contract's schedule. If a payment has no invoice yet, it is issued on its own that day; to do it earlier, create it from Invoices.
upcoming.concepts: {first} and {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}
